source_webpage_text:
Terminal Procedure: Conveyor Start-up for Ship Unloading

Before starting a ship-unloading run, the control-room operator confirms that the receiving route is available and that the designated storage area has capacity for the planned cargo. The operator checks in with the berth supervisor and confirms that personnel are clear of the conveyor route.

Start the receiving conveyor route from the downstream end toward the vessel, following the control-room start-up sequence. The ship unloader may begin conveying cargo only after the control room confirms that the full receiving route is running. If a route alarm occurs, stop cargo feed, notify the berth supervisor, and follow the terminal's fault-response procedure before restarting.
